synthetic_noise_disclaimer: SYNTHETIC NOISE, NOT DEMAND/MUSAN. CLAUDE.md prescribes DEMAND PSTATION + DKITCHEN and MUSAN; neither corpus is on disk and the Kaggle kernel has no Internet, so the noise here is generated deterministically from a seed. Results are valid for relative comparison within this run only and are NOT comparable to published numbers on DEMAND or MUSAN. The paper must rerun this grid on the real corpora before any noise-robustness claim ships.

notes: ASR runs with vad_filter=False so the measured damage is the noise, not faster-whisper's internal VAD; clean WER here is therefore not identical to the vad_filter=True numbers in Results/kaggle_t4.
SNR is referenced to the RMS of the speech-active region, not the whole file, so leading/trailing silence does not shift the level.
Denoiser enhancement is reported as SI-SDR improvement measured in this run; the +10.4 dB in prototype/EDGE_UPGRADES.md is NOT reused.

headline.interpretation: A positive wer_delta means GTCRN made the transcript WORSE than the raw noisy audio. Perceptual enhancement (SI-SDR up) and ASR accuracy can move in opposite directions; if they do here, the deployment decision follows WER, not SI-SDR.
headline.caveat: SYNTHETIC NOISE, NOT DEMAND/MUSAN. CLAUDE.md prescribes DEMAND PSTATION + DKITCHEN and MUSAN; neither corpus is on disk and the Kaggle kernel has no Internet, so the noise here is generated deterministically from a seed. Results are valid for relative comparison within this run only and are NOT comparable to published numbers on DEMAND or MUSAN. The paper must rerun this grid on the real corpora before any noise-robustness claim ships.
